title: Rectangular determinant switch identity
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $m,n\geq0$ integers. For matrices $A\in\operatorname{Mat}_{m\times n}(R)$ and $B\in\operatorname{Mat}_{n\times m}(R)$ [def-weil-matrix], one has
$$\det(I_m+AB)=\det(I_n+BA).$$
Here $I_t$ is the identity matrix of size $t$, matrix multiplication is $(AB)_{ij}=\sum_k A_{ik}B_{kj}$, and the determinant of a $t\times t$ matrix $X$ is $\sum_{\sigma\in S_t}\operatorname{sgn}(\sigma)\prod_{i=1}^tX_{i,\sigma(i)}$, with determinant $1$ in size zero.
